body: I rush across the lawn, my heart pounding, as the surveyor's tape looms before me. The tree, its branches tangled with ivy, seems to be waiting for me. I glance around, trying to find a safe path, but every direction seems to lead back to the tree. I feel a chill run down my spine as I approach the treeline, my hand instinctively reaching for a nearby rock to steady myself.
